sourceNotes: Templates use per-row placeholders so KnowledgeItems are not identical across OEs.
Chapter/standard titles come from Masterchapters.csv and Standards.csv joins on CSV Ids.
whyItMattersTemplate: Within chapter {ChapterTitle}, objective element {Code} (title: {Title}) is a measurable checkpoint under parent requirement {StandardCode}. It implements: {StandardTitle}. Meeting this OE demonstrates structured practice for NABH 6th Edition in this domain, reduces patient-safety and operational risk in {ApplicableDepartments}, and provides assessable evidence for survey.
howToComplyTemplate: 1) Assign accountability: {OwnerRole} with {ApplicableDepartments} participation. 2) Align SOPs/work instructions to {Code} and the intent of {StandardCode}. 3) Train and competency-check staff; retain records. 4) Run monitoring (audits, KPIs, committee review) for scope {ApplicableScope}. 5) Collect evidence per {EvidenceType} expectations. 6) Track NC/CAPA to closure with evidence.
evidenceRequiredIntroTemplate: For {Code} under {StandardCode}, maintain retrievable evidence suitable for {EvidenceType} review:

evidenceRequiredByEvidenceType.Document: controlled policies/procedures; approvals; registers; completed forms; patient/staff records; meeting minutes; improvement plans.
evidenceRequiredByEvidenceType.Interview: staff awareness (sampling); structured interviews; competency verification; escalation paths documented.
evidenceRequiredByEvidenceType.Observation: direct observation checklists; environment/safety walkthrough records; time-stamped survey notes where methodology allows.
evidenceRequiredByEvidenceType.As Applicable: policies, records, and artefacts proportionate to scope and departmental practice.
evidenceRequiredByEvidenceType.default: policies, registers, logs, and records proportionate to the OE; traceable approvals; and improvement evidence.

evidenceRequiredClosing: Also retain metadata for traceability (version, author, date). NABH 6th Edition surveys may use structured evidence including app-based or photographic artefacts where the methodology permits.
auditChecklistTemplate:
OE {Code} ({Title}) - parent {StandardCode}
- Mapped to chapter {ChapterCode}: {ChapterTitle}.
- Owner: {OwnerRole}; departments: {ApplicableDepartments}.
- Current policy/SOP and training records available.
- Operational records / sampling for {ApplicableScope}.
- Evidence pack for {EvidenceType} ready.
- KPIs/committees reviewed; NC/CAPA closed with evidence.
